message.alamodlist.failed: Could not open the mod list preview.
message.alamodlist.sent: Your mod list is ready (mods: %s, libraries: %s).
message.alamodlist.sent.expires: The link stays for %s days after the last view.
message.alamodlist.sent.truncated: Some very long texts were shortened.
message.alamodlist.sent.not_deletable: The site gave no delete token, so this list cannot be deleted from the game.
message.alamodlist.sent.token_memory: The delete token could not be saved to disk. You can delete this list only until you close the game.
message.alamodlist.button.open.hover: Open the page of the list
message.alamodlist.button.delete.hover: Delete this list from the site
message.alamodlist.list.empty: You have not made a list yet. Use /alamodlist to make one.
message.alamodlist.delete.ask: Delete the list "%s" from the site? This cannot be undone.
message.alamodlist.delete.no_token: The list "%s" cannot be deleted from the game: its delete token is not stored here.
message.alamodlist.delete.unknown: No such list in your history.
message.alamodlist.delete.gone: The list "%s" is already gone from the site; it was removed from your history.
message.alamodlist.error.contract: The mod and the site disagree about the format of a list. Update the mod.
message.alamodlist.error.limit: The list is too big for the site. Switch a category off and send again.
message.alamodlist.error.token: The site does not accept your account token. Issue a new one in your profile.
message.alamodlist.error.rate_limit: Too many requests. Try again in %s min.
message.alamodlist.error.gone: That list is no longer on the site.
message.alamodlist.error.delete_token: The site did not accept the delete token for this list. The list was kept.
message.alamodlist.error.server: The site is not available right now. Try again later.
message.alamodlist.error.offline: Could not reach the site. Check your connection.
message.alamodlist.error.timeout_unknown: The site did not answer in time. The list may have been created without the link reaching you; sending again may make a second one.
message.alamodlist.error.timeout: The site did not answer in time. Try again.
message.alamodlist.error.tls: Could not make a secure connection to the site (certificate problem).
message.alamodlist.error.gate: The privacy check stopped the list. Nothing was sent.
message.alamodlist.error.invalid_id: That is not a list id.
message.alamodlist.error.internal: Something went wrong inside the mod. Nothing was sent.
message.alamodlist.error.bad_address: The site address in the settings (apiBaseUrl) cannot be used. It must start with http:// or https://.
screen.alamodlist.preview.title: Ala Modlist
screen.alamodlist.preview.status.ready: Nothing leaves your computer until you press Send.
screen.alamodlist.preview.status.unhashe: %s files could not be read in time and go without a hash; the site cannot match them.
screen.alamodlist.preview.status.cancell: Cancelled. Press Refresh to collect again.
screen.alamodlist.preview.status.collect: Could not collect the list. Press Refresh to try again.
screen.alamodlist.preview.status.blocked: The privacy check stopped the list. Nothing was sent.
screen.alamodlist.gate.title: The privacy check stopped this list
screen.alamodlist.gate.explain: Nothing was sent. Something that identifies you was found. Remove it, for example from the title, and press Send again.
screen.alamodlist.gate.found.other: something that must not be sent
config.alamodlist.title: Ala Modlist Settings
config.alamodlist.answerInActionBar.tool: On: short messages of the mod appear above the hotbar. Off: in chat.
config.alamodlist.computeMurmur2.tooltip: On: also compute the CurseForge fingerprint of every jar. It reads each jar a second time, so collecting takes longer. Off: only SHA-1.
config.alamodlist.apiBaseUrl.tooltip: Where lists are sent. Keep the default unless you run your own copy of the site, for example a local one. It must start with http:// or https://.
